source_custody.substitution_policy: Guidance derivation must read only derivation_input by git commit and path. Live workspace bytes are observed custody evidence only and must never substitute for that frozen object.

mechanical_transformation.source: For each condition, read the H2 atom_catalog row matching each H3 eligibility rule in frozen H3 order.
algorithm: For each H3 eligibility rule in order, select the sole H2 condition atom_catalog row at the same derived-atom position.

Emit one anonymous guidance group with the rule positive_predicates in order, the rule exclusion_predicate, and the selected row declared_scope, positive_boundary, and admission_rule in source bytes after JSON decoding.
Emit no other source field and preserve the resulting group order.

packet_contract.instruction: Extract only the ordered predicate facts supported by task text using the supplied predicate order and anonymous condition guidance. Return only the frozen predicate_facts JSON object.
packet_contract.task_text: caller-supplied task text only; no task text is stored in this adapter
packet_contract.condition_variance: Only condition_guidance may differ between condition packets for the same task text.

parent_resolution_boundary.authority: H3 protocol, frozen reference policy, and frozen base manifest provenance only
